formula_reserved_name: The name "{name}" is already used by the variable {variable}
formula_statements: A formula has to be a single expression, e.g. without semicolons
formula_out_of_scope: {variable} is only available inside of the list "{list}", e.g. in {example}

formula_compare_text_with_equal_text: Text can't be compared with {operator}, use equalText(a, b) instead

formula_self_reference: The formula refers to its own field {variable}
formula_calculation_loop: The calculation depends on itself, e.g. through another calculation
